_about: Every asset kind growth-makeyourmindup used to make, mapped to the v5 Library command and set that makes it in content-engine now. Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-26): "I believe that growth should move all asset production to Content Engine. I see no point in having a separate repository produce specific assets." Then: "I want everything to be one harmonious engine." The v5 Library is locked (26 Nov 2026; Krish: "I approve the new cover thumbnail systems, go"), so Growth's HTML renderer, templates, kit.css, fit.js, fonts, brand PNGs, piece kits, kits.py, tall_meme.py and video_cover.py are retired, never moved: the Library templates are the only artwork. scripts/post-pack/asset_routes.py reads this file, prints the command for a kind, and refuses when the Library is not on the checkout. tests/asset_routes_test.py holds it to the Library's registry.
split: content-engine makes every asset (hero pieces, carousels, memes, Substack Notes images and words, captions and titles per channel, covers, thumbnails, cuts, the weekly edition package) and hands Growth finished, approved assets with their captions in the piece manifest; growth-makeyourmindup grows the channel: it posts, schedules in Buffer, places the edition in Substack, distributes, runs the subscribe route, measures and reports performance back.

absent_detail: {script} is not on this checkout. It lands with the v5 Library (content-engine branch library/gates-and-wiring). Nothing else makes this asset: no other renderer, no Growth template, no hand-drawn stand-in. Wait for the Library to reach main, then run the command again.

covers.writes: covers.json, read by post-pack as cover_set
covers.rule: Covers and thumbnails come only from this command. The family pick is automatic: the first family the facts support that differs from the previous published piece's. make_piece.py --set covers and --set video are retired.

carousel.rule: Carousels come only from this command, in the set's registry order (library.json carousel_sets), to the 3-second swipe (CAROUSEL-FORMAT.md). It never invents words: every slot comes from the piece.
